blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `setTaxLinesForItemsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step sets the tax lines of shipping methods and line items in a cart.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

children.description: The details of the tax lines to set in a cart.
